combo1.title: Endymion Full Combo Line (Advanced)
combo1.description: Advanced full combo line weaving together the Magistus, Spellbook, Witchcrafter, Sky Striker, and Mythical Beast engines. Not recommended for beginners — requires precise sequencing across 200+ steps. This is a specific draw loop variant of the deck, distinct from the standard Endymion line (which ends on multiple negates via Servant → Electrumite → Selene). The core of the draw loop: Royal Magical Library accumulates spell counters from each spell activation and cashes them in for free draws, while Wonder Wand draws 2 by sending itself and its equipped monster to the GY, and Pot of Avarice recycles monsters back into the deck for another two draws — each cycle fuelling the next until you have enough resources to establish the full end board with multiple Endymion bounce negates and set backrow.
